text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Shuka Sho has finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The main focus has gotta be Almond Eye and 
Lucky Lilac...! Today's race is gonna be 
insane~...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara is seriously hyped this 
year! I wonder what kind of run Almond Eye 
will show us today...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's the destination of the Tiara.
Yeah. It's the final stop of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer and I have done everything we 
possibly could leading up to this Shuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We overcame the issues with my body 
together... and to win right here today... 
we've built up so much...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I have confidence. I have pride. I'm going 
to charge in with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please bear witness. To the grand 
culmination of our Triple Tiara campaign.
choice_data_list: And let's bloom with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely. Let us gaze out upon it 
together from the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
This Kyoto Racecourse, colored by my 
running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Those two are super conscious of 
each other...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like today's race will center 
around those two as well. Can't take my 
eyes off them...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just my imagination. You've 
grown bigger. Both in body and in 
heart...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala has become even stronger for today's 
race too, hasn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's right. ...I've poured everything 
into this moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you too. Everything I've built 
up for today!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...You're totally raring to go, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...To win today, I turned adversity into 
fuel and trained hard.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And yet here you are—standing firmly in 
my way, aren't you...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, you're always like this. ...Not 
that it matters today—!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely not handin' over the final 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Are ya ready to look at my back?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's not done.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because the one who's going to win is me!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who should look forward to 
it! To a run with everything I have poured 
into it!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ai-san really has always been that way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'll shut that fiery spirit of yours 
right up on this final stage!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's make this a race worthy 
of our final destination.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Time to start. —Our "Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Can Lucky Lilac achieve the Triple 
Tiara...? It all depends on how Almond Eye 
moves...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to see a Triple Tiara after all 
this time~. But I also kind of want to see 
Almond Eye get her revenge, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's the destination of the Tiara.
Yeah. It's the final stop of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer and I have done everything we 
possibly could leading up to this Shuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We overcame the issues with my body 
together... and to win right here today... 
we've built up so much...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I have confidence. I have the pride of the 
Double Tiara. I'm going to charge in with 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please bear witness. To the grand 
culmination of our Triple Tiara campaign.
choice_data_list:
Let's loudly proclaim who the true Queen 
is!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely. Let us gaze out upon it 
together from the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
For my running, and the brilliance of the 
Tiara, to color this Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Those two are super conscious of 
each other...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like today's race will center 
around those two as well. Can't take my 
eyes off them...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I finally defeat you. 
Everything I've built up was for this 
moment...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll put everything I've got into this! 
And I will prove myself!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That right now, I'm the stronger one!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I ain't givin' it up.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Every single time, I bust my butt to 
finally win, just tryin' to shake ya off 
once and for all.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even for this Shuka Sho, I used adversity 
to fuel my desperate training just to 
win...! And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You haven't broken in the slightest, and 
you're stepping up to challenge me again 
today... Just how badly do you wanna win, 
huh...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, you really are always like 
this. ...Still—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take that Triple Tiara for 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I'm definitely going to win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll say it as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely someone like you that I 
want to beat!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ai-san really has always, always been 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And that's precisely why— On this final 
stage, I'm gonna make damn sure you 
realize ya can never beat me!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as ya wished, I'll let ya experience 
the Queen's running from the closest seat 
in the house.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Shall we get started? —On our "Shuka Sho."
